title: Store Pickup Standard: Store-Wait Multiplier on Damage Allowances for Paid-in-Full Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
The longer a ready Ridgeline Special Order Services item waited at the store before pickup or delivery, the higher the store-wait multiplier on the damage allowance of an order in a program paid in full at order.

**Clause.** The store-wait multiplier depends on the calendar days from the ready date to the completed date: more than 14 days gives a multiplier of 1.1; more than 7 days but not more than 14 days gives 1.05; otherwise the store-wait multiplier is 1.

The damage allowance is multiplied by the store-wait multiplier in the same product as the delivered price and the percentage at which the allowance is figured, before that product is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Terms used

- **The ready date** is the date the item became ready for pickup or delivery; **the completed date** is the date of pickup or delivery.

## Day bands

| Calendar days from ready date to completed date | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 15 or more | 1.1 |
| 8 to 14 | 1.05 |
| 0 to 7 | 1 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical ready date 2 June)

| Completed date | Days | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 9 June | 7 | 1 |
| 10 June | 8 | 1.05 |
| 16 June | 14 | 1.05 |
| 17 June | 15 | 1.1 |
